title: Title & Registration Services Late-Registration Penalty Reimbursement: Policy Entry and System Reference for the Reimbursement Tool
content:
## Policy entry

A buyer under Title & Registration Services may ask Kestrel to reimburse a state late-registration penalty. A state late-registration penalty is reimbursed when the service type reimburses late penalties, the first submission missed the state's dealer deadline, and the customer returned every required document within the customer document due days.

The late-penalty reimbursement is not fixed until the late-registration penalty named on the order's most recent fee-shortage return stands collected on the order as its own fee entry.

The late-penalty reimbursement is booked only after the order's ledger shows a remittance to the state dated on or after its most recent fee-shortage return.

Restated in the same terms: while no late-registration penalty stands collected on the order as its own fee entry after its most recent fee-shortage return, the reimbursement is not fixed; and while the ledger shows no remittance to the state dated on or after that return, the reimbursement is not booked.

| Condition | Must hold |
|---|---|
| the service type reimburses late penalties | yes |
| the first submission missed the state's dealer deadline | yes |
| every required document was returned within the customer document due days | yes |

## System reference: `reimburse_title_late_penalty_e7fb1913`

**Capability.** Pays the buyer a reimbursement toward a state late-registration penalty on a title and registration order. One call books one reimbursement paid to the buyer, dated that day, against the state penalty notice whose number is passed, with the reason recorded as a state late-registration penalty. The buyer sees the reimbursement on the order's history at once.

**Invocation.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it through `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `title_order_id` | the reference number of the title and registration order, as shown by the title and registration order lookup for this buyer before the call | identifier, copied as shown |
| `citation_number` | the state penalty notice number exactly as printed on the notice and as shown on the state's return in the order's history | verbatim, character for character with its letters, digits and hyphens, without translation, normalisation, summary, addition or deletion |
| `amount` | the reimbursement paid | USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent; booked exactly as passed |

**Return.** A receipt with `status` reading `reimbursement_paid` on success, `title_txn_id` (reference number of the reimbursement entry), `title_order_id`, `citation_number` (as booked), `reimbursement_reason` (always `state_late_registration_penalty`), `amount` (USD with 2 decimal places) and `txn_date` (payment date, YYYY-MM-DD). No error responses are defined for this tool.
